parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit has one file, user.entity.ts, which declares one class, UserEntity. That class is a TypeORM persistence mapping for the 'user' table and does nothing else. It extends EntityRelationalHelper, the project's shared base for relational entities. It links to other entities only through standard TypeORM decorators (@OneToOne FileEntity, @ManyToOne RoleEntity and StatusEntity). The single rule that appears here, the default provider value, comes from AuthProvidersEnum.email rather than being repeated as a literal. The file holds no business logic, no duplicated invariants, and no unrelated concerns, and it doesn't work around the module's own abstractions. The layer model puts this path in the domain layer even though it sits under infrastructure/persistence. That is a layer-placement question, and the rule says layer questions are out of scope.
